meta.title: A vendor with a technical response cannot be removed from the RFP

words.preconditions: A fresh published RFP + RFQ event where the invited QA vendor has submitted its technical response; rounds still open.
steps: The buyer sends the trade remove audience request, exactly as the matching library case writes it.
words.expected: The app refuses the step the case is about with “You cannot remove a vendor who has already participated.”, and never with a server error.

plan.title: A vendor with a technical response cannot be removed from the RFP
